relationships.subject: Brilliant Blue G
relationships.evidence_quote: the pain threshold of rats caused by pulpitis was increased by intraperitoneal injection of Brilliant Blue G (BBG), a P2X7 inhibitor

relationships.subject: Brilliant Blue G
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression levels of NLRP3 and related inflammatory factors IL-1β and IL-18 were decreased

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: the P2X7regulates NLRP3 pathway in the context of dental inflammatory pain conduction

key_findings: Pulpitis lowered pain threshold with increased NLRP3, caspase-1, P2X7, IL-1beta and IL-18 in trigeminal ganglion and medullary dorsal horn.
The P2X7 inhibitor BBG raised pain threshold and reduced NLRP3, IL-1beta and IL-18.
